data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for offline document scanning, QR/barcode scanning, and OCR data capture.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready-to-use UI and APIs for capturing documents, automatic cropping, applying image filters, and extracting data from MRZs, check MICR, VINs, and barcodes entirely on-device.
use_when: You need robust offline document scanning with auto-cropping and perspective correction.
Your app requires data extraction modules like MRZ (passports/IDs), barcodes, or VIN scanning.
avoid_when: You only need a simple, lightweight camera preview without heavy document processing features.
You require a completely free open-source solution with no commercial licensing fees.
strengths: High-level Ready-To-Use UI components for fast integration.
Runs entirely offline without sending data to external servers.
Includes advanced features like automatic capture, user guidance, and document quality analysis.
weaknesses: Requires a commercial license key for long-term usage (free 60-second trial per session otherwise).
Large SDK footprint due to comprehensive native scanning binaries.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding CAMERA permission and configuration in AndroidManifest.xml and iOS Info.plist, plus SDK initialization with a license key.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: You only need lightweight, high-performance barcode and QR scanning without document workflow features.

alternatives.name: cunning_document_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: You want a simpler free document cropping scanner wrapper.
